name: connectsphere
description: Convenience scripts to start/test the whole ConnectSphere stack from the repo root. See README.md.

scripts.setup: npm install && uv --directory backend sync && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix tests install && npm --prefix tests exec -- playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: uv --directory backend run ruff check . && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.format: uv --directory backend run ruff format . && npm --prefix frontend run format
